notes: These are coaching-provider classifications, not an official IIM topic taxonomy. Retain the IMS provider identity when combining rows across years.

Do not combine the Career Launcher QA vectors with these IMS vectors without question-level recoding. In particular, logarithms, functions and progressions may be assigned to different broad categories.
The 2021 sources do not define the contents of Modern Math as explicitly as the 2022 Slot 2 source. Holding the provider constant reduces but does not eliminate taxonomy uncertainty.

The page https://www.imsindia.com/ims-cat-2024-ananlysis/ displays 2023 analysis despite its URL. Its 2021 and 2022 archive cards point to javascript:void(0), so they did not supply usable archive links.

These sources were inspected retrospectively on 2026-09-08. Their historical article dates and exam-year labels are not evidence of immutable pre-cutoff snapshots. A replay using these rows must not be described as an originally issued or genuinely blind forecast.

The 2022 Slot 2 page displays a publication date of 23 November 2022 while describing the completed examination. This date inconsistency is not used as evidence that its analysis existed before the exam.
